name: Samvardhana Motherson International Ltd.
business_summary: Global tier-1 auto supplier (Motherson Group flagship). Wiring harnesses (with Motherson Sumi Wiring India), rear-view mirrors and vision systems, plastic bumpers/dashboards and modules (Peguform, SMRC), plus new businesses (aerospace, medical, electronics, logistics, defence connectors). Roughly 80% of revenue outside India, led by Europe (~40-45%) and Americas (~20%) (model knowledge); customers include VW, BMW, Mercedes, Stellantis, GM, JLR. Consolidated debt is material (net debt/EBITDA ~1.3x, model knowledge). Shares +59.7% in 12 months; 1:2 bonus in 2025; acquiring 50.1% of defence connector maker Rotary Connectors (EV Rs 500 cr, announced 2026-09-21). Screener dossier unavailable; consolidated Q2 FY27 not retrieved.

exposures.mechanism: Europe is ~40-45% of consolidated revenue (model knowledge: SMRC, SMP vision/modules, wiring for VW, BMW, Stellantis, Mercedes, JLR). +1pp European light-vehicle demand growth => +0.45% revenue; decremental/incremental margin ~25% vs ~10.5% EBITDA and ~5.5% EBIT => EBIT +2%; EV/MCap ~1.15-1.2 (net debt); persistence 0.5-0.6 => +1.2-1.4.

evidence.note: Regional mix is an estimate; Q2 FY27 consolidated not retrieved

exposures.mechanism: Americas ~20% of revenue (Mexico/US wiring and modules, GM/Ford/Stellantis/Honda). +1pp US auto demand => +0.2% revenue; EBIT +1%; x1.2 x0.6 => +0.7, plus operating leverage and Mexico USMCA exposure => +1.2.

India is ~20% of revenue (Motherson Sumi Wiring India Q2 FY27 revenue +47% y/y to Rs 4,055 cr, per scanx) plus Indian modules/polymers and SAMIL's stake economics. +10% Indian volumes => +2% group revenue => EBIT +9% => x1.2 x0.5 => ~+3.0-5.

Wiring harness copper cost is contractually passed through with a 1-3 month lag (MSWIL expects copper-cost recovery within FY27, Multibagg 2026-11-05). +10% copper => ~0.06% of revenue temporarily unrecovered => EBITDA -0.6% plus working-capital drag. Empirical +1.22 (t=1.6) is cyclical co-movement, not a cost benefit; range straddles zero.

Aluminium in die-cast/modules ~3% of costs, mostly indexed; +10% => unrecovered ~0.05% of revenue. Empirical +2.59 (t=2.9) disagrees with the fundamental sign: aluminium co-moves with global industrial cycle and the stock's 1.56 beta; the model weight is shrunk toward the data (range up to +0.6) but kept slightly negative on cost logic. Aluminium -19.6% since June.

Polymer resins (polypropylene, ABS) for bumpers/modules: SMRC polymers ~12% of revenue are resin-intensive; +10% Brent => ~+5% resin => 0.6% of revenue gross, ~30% unrecovered over a quarter => EBITDA -1.7% x1.2 x0.3 => -0.6.
European plants face energy cost inflation; energy ~2% of costs, partial pass-through. +15% gas => EBITDA -1.5% x1.2 x0.3 => -0.5.

China (SMRC, Samvardhana Motherson Peguform) ~7% of revenue; empirical -5.37 (t=-2.7) per +3% USD/CNY is significant, mostly a proxy for global risk-off and China/Europe auto demand. Model: translation -0.2% of revenue; blend with data => -1.5.

~80% of revenue and ~75% of EBITDA is earned in EUR/USD/other and consolidated into INR. +3% USD/INR (INR weaker) => reported EBITDA +2.3%; debt is also foreign, so net equity effect +1.2 after x1.2 x0.5.
Beta 1.5 and elevated valuation after +59.7% in 12m; +25bp => ~-2% DCF; net debt amplifies it.

Net debt (~Rs 25,000 cr, model knowledge) is ~50% floating USD/EUR; +25bp => ~Rs 31 cr extra interest vs PBT ~Rs 4,800 cr => -0.65% PBT x1.2 x0.5 => -0.4. Empirical +1.69 (t=1.0) is positive and insignificant (policy-rate rises coincide with strong global demand).
OEM line stoppages (Nexperia-type shock, 2025 precedent) cut SAMIL's schedules: +1 => -3% revenue; operating leverage 25% on 10.5% EBITDA => EBITDA -7% x1.2 x0.4 => -3.

Mexico/US-built wiring and modules cross the border under USMCA; +10pp average US auto-parts tariff is largely passed to OEMs but with volume loss and negotiation lag. US-Mexico talks stalled on metal/auto tariffs (CNBC TV18 2026-10-21). +1 => EBIT -2.5% x1.2 x0.7 => -2.
EVs raise wiring and module content per vehicle; SAMIL is brand-agnostic and has no ICE-specific profit pool. +1 => +0.7% revenue at average margin => +1.
